sources.excerpt: “Bitcoin consumes ‘more electricity than Argentina” – BBC. “Bitcoin’s wild ride renews worries about its

reasoning: According to the Cambridge Bitcoin Electricity Consumption Index (CBECI) and energy data from the International Energy Agency (IEA), Bitcoin's annualized electricity consumption is estimated to be between 140 and 160 Terawatt-hours (TWh) as of late 2023/2024. This exceeds the total annual electricity consumption of Argentina, which is approximately 130 to 135 TWh. This widely reported comparison, initially brought to prominence by Cambridge researchers in 2021 when Bitcoin's consumption was around 121 TWh, remains true today as the growth in Bitcoin's mining hash rate has continued to outpace the electricity demand of many mid-sized nations.
